learning_extracted: When fixing a degenerate instrument defect on one side of a correlation test, check whether the same defect class could exist on the other side before trusting the corrected read.
A prerequisite claim being 'gate cleared to test' (substrate now supports the experiment) is not the same as 'confirmed operative' -- MECH-025's evidence:None is a real gap.
Single-seed correlational tests on philosophical-bridge claims (no direct biological literature) warrant a higher evidentiary bar before being read as claim pressure.
